svg.title: Two requests for seat 14C at the same instant
svg.desc: Top: check-then-act in the application. Both requests read available before either writes, both write held, and both users are told the seat is theirs. Bottom: one conditional UPDATE each. Request 1 takes the row lock and commits; request 2 waits for the lock, re-checks its WHERE clause against the new row, matches nothing, updates zero rows and returns 409.
svg.text: one winner, decided by the row lock
